query: with ins as ( insert into queue.jobs (id, kind, payload, state, run_at, priority) select $1, $2, $3, 'available', coalesce($4, now()), $5 where not exists ( select 1 from queue.jobs where kind = $2 and payload = $3 and state = 'available') returning kind) select pg_notify('loom_queue:' || kind, '') from ins
